messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
Here’s a concise overview of key Texas traffic laws and regulations: | Area | Key Points | |------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• Rural interstate highways: 70 mph (except 55 mph on I‑35).
• Urban interstate highways: 65 mph.
• School zones: 25 mph during school hours. | | **Seat Belt & Child Restraint** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 years or weighing <80 lb must use a child safety seat. | | **Cell Phone Use** | • Handheld phone use while driving is prohibited; hands‑free devices allowed.
• Texting while driving is illegal. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) ≥0.08 % is illegal for drivers over 21.
• Zero tolerance (<0.02 %) applies to drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, mandatory education, and possible jail time. | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red lights: stop before the line; proceed only when clear and green.
• Stop signs: come to a complete stop at the intersection or crosswalk.
• Yield signs: slow down and yield to pedestrians and other vehicles. | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the vehicle on the right has priority.
• Pedestrians always have priority at crosswalks. | | **School Bus Laws** | • Vehicles must stop within 20 ft of a stopped school bus displaying red lights.
• Drivers may not pass a stopped school bus until it resumes motion. | | **Lane Discipline** | • Keep left lane except when passing or turning right.
• Do not drive in the wrong lane or reverse on a highway. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a driveway entrance.
• No parking in front of fire hydrants or on sidewalks. | | **Vehicle Equipment** | • Headlights must be used from sunset to sunrise and during inclement weather.
• Mirrors must be adjusted to eliminate blind spots. | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 bodily injury per person, $60,000 total per accident, $25,000 property damage.
• Proof of insurance must be carried in the vehicle. | ### How to Find Recent Traffic‑Related Lawsuits in Texas If you’re interested in recent legal cases involving traffic violations or road safety issues, you can use the `lawsuit_search` tool. For example, to look up lawsuits filed in 2024 concerning speeding violations in Dallas County, you would call: ```json { "location": "Dallas County", "subject": "speeding", "year": 2024 } ``` Feel free to let me know if you’d like me to run a specific search or dive deeper into any of the topics above!
